name: @valuescan/copy-engine
description: The live copy-trading engine shared by every ValueDesk copier: the browser copier, the hosted executor and the self-hosted executor. Copy rules, the planner that turns a leader's position change into follower orders, the jurisdiction policy, the copy fee ladder, the SoDEX client, the leader feeds (SoDEX and Hyperliquid) and the signed executor API. Pure TypeScript + @noble via sodex-core; fetch and WebSocket are injected.
